images.filename: Flag of the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army.png
images.caption: A reconstruction of the flag used by the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army (ARSA) in their publicly-released press statements and videos. The flag is a horizontal tricolour of white, red, and green, the shades of the latter two colours reflecting those used in the flags of earlier Rohingya organisations. Two heads of wheat are on the white band.
images.alt: A reconstruction of the flag used by the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army (ARSA) in their publicly-released press statements and videos.
